name: Olov
niche: Restaurant: modern Uzbek cooking over live fire

seo.title: Olov — open-fire restaurant in Tashkent, table booking
seo.description: Modern Uzbek cooking over wood, embers and tandoor in central Tashkent. Marbled beef shashlik, oven-baked samsa, regional wines. Open for bookings until 02:00.
seo.answer: Olov is an open-fire restaurant at 41 Amir Temur St., Tashkent: modern Uzbek dishes from the oven, the grill and the tandoor. The average bill is 250–350 thousand UZS per guest; open daily from 12:00, until 02:00 on Fridays and weekends. Book a table on +998 71 200-00-12.

listing.description: A website for a restaurant, grill bar or café. WebGL fire and sparks, a menu like a printed card, a booking button, an ‘open until’ status, the chef and a gallery.

sections.title: Everything delicious starts with fire
sections.subtitle: Uzbek food cooked the way it has been for centuries — over apricot wood, saxaul embers and in a clay tandoor. We just look at it with fresh eyes.

sections.label: Kitchen
sections.title: We don’t hide the fire in the kitchen — it’s in the middle of the room
sections.text:
A 12-metre open kitchen: an oven, a grill and two tandoors. You see the flatbread rise, the fat melt on the skewer and the chef taste the sauce.
Our meat comes from farmers in Jizzakh and we dry-age it ourselves for 21 days. Vegetables come from Chorsu market every morning. Bread is baked from opening until the last guest.

sections.label: Chef
sections.title: A kitchen that holds its own by the fire

sections.label: Events
sections.title: Celebrations and dinners
sections.intro: We close the room, put together a set menu and assign a dedicated grill master.

items.title: Banquet for up to 40
items.text: A private room with a fireplace and its own menu.

items.title: Dinner by the fire
items.text: A table for 8 by the open kitchen, a 7-course set from the chef.

items.title: Full buyout
items.text: The whole room and terrace for your event, up to 120 guests.

items.quote: The tandir gosht melts and the bread arrives still hot. The best dinner in town for guests from abroad.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: We sat by the open kitchen and watched the fire all evening. The chef came over himself to talk about dry-ageing.
items.author: Alexey

items.quote: We celebrated my father’s anniversary with 30 guests — the room, the menu and the cake went off without a single hitch.
items.author: Behzod

items.q: How do I book a table?
items.a: By phone on +998 71 200-00-12 or on Telegram @olov_table, daily from 11:00. We hold a booking for 20 minutes; for Friday and Saturday, book 2–3 days ahead.
About 250–350 thousand UZS per guest without drinks. Service is 10%.
Yes, free guarded parking in the courtyard for 25 cars, plus valet on Friday and Saturday evenings.
Yes, a private room for 40 with a fireplace — from 380,000 UZS per guest, booked 3 days ahead. The whole restaurant takes up to 120 guests, on request.
Of course: there are high chairs, a kids’ menu and colouring books. The open kitchen is behind glass.
Yes: charcoal aubergine and vegetables, achichuk, meat-free hummus, flatbreads and pumpkin samsa in season. Tell your waiter and the chef will advise.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: The fire burns every evening
sections.text: Call us and we’ll find you a table by the kitchen, on the terrace or in a quiet corner.
